offering_description.value: Underwrites specialty property and casualty insurance, mainly casualty, professional liability, healthcare liability, excess and surplus lines and property coverages for commercial clients. Sells through wholesale and retail brokers and takes on risk through its insurance carrier subsidiaries.

primary_products.value: general casualty insurance; professional liability insurance; healthcare liability insurance; excess casualty insurance; property insurance

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial businesses, professional firms and healthcare organizations buying specialty insurance via brokers

end_markets.value: construction; healthcare; professional services; real estate; commercial businesses

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums written and earned, plus investment income on the portfolio; commissions or management fees: fees and commissions from program and fronting arrangements
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: risk-bearing insurance carrier underwriting policies sourced from brokers and sold to commercial policyholders

geography_served.value: US national: Admitted and surplus lines business across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: casualty, professional liability, healthcare liability, excess and surplus lines, and property

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: wholesale and retail insurance brokers placing specialty risks

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Licensed insurer regulated by state insurance departments, with solvency, rate and filing requirements
